response.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(CAST(l.derived_total_cost AS REAL) / l.derived_product_cost) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON i.invoice_number = l.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10
